generic_sampling_rules.int_primary_key: sequential integers starting at 1, unique per table; PK columns are never NULL and never duplicated, so group_sizes/aggregate_boundary patterns cannot be planted on them
generic_sampling_rules.int_foreign_key: sample from parent primary-key pool; allow NULL only if column nullable; for group_sizes/aggregate_boundary patterns on a nullable FK, plant repeated parent values (including one group of size 1, one of size 2, one of size >= 3) and at least one NULL row
generic_sampling_rules.int_numeric: uniform integer within [min, max] from statistics; step 1
generic_sampling_rules.text_short: sample from a small pool of realistic values; allow near-variants (case, trailing space, prefix/suffix) at 10-20% of rows
generic_sampling_rules.text_code: sample from explicit enum pool when distinct <= 12
generic_sampling_rules.text_date: format YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD as observed; keep order rules
generic_sampling_rules.text_nullable: with probability equal to observed null_rate (min 1 row per instance), emit NULL; otherwise sample non-null value
generic_sampling_rules.distinct_duplicates: for DISTINCT-target columns, ensure duplicate_share 20-50% by drawing from a pool of size ~0.6*rows
generic_sampling_rules.group_sizes: for GROUP-target non-key columns, ensure at least one group of size 1, one of size 2, and one of size >= 3; for n < 6 relax the '>= 3' target to the largest feasible group
generic_sampling_rules.aggregate_boundary: for HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 targets on non-key columns, ensure at least one group with count 0 or 1 and one with count >= 2
generic_sampling_rules.ties_for_order_limit: for ORDER/LIMIT targets, plant ties at the listed rank (e.g. rank 10 or 1000) by repeating the boundary value; for 'any (no LIMIT)' targets skip planting
generic_sampling_rules.like_near_variant: for LIKE/equality literal targets, include the exact literal plus near-variants (case change, trailing space, extra suffix, truncated prefix)
generic_sampling_rules.comparison_boundary: for <> literal targets, include the literal itself and one-step variants (case, trailing space, truncation) so both sides of the comparison occur; these variants are part of the column's sampling domain and must be consistent with any enum/range rule
generic_sampling_rules.null_rows: for IS NULL / IS NOT NULL targets, plant NULL share 5-30% of generated rows in that column
